newsitem.title: INDIA: Standard & Poor's to take 9.6 pct stake in CRISIL.
newsitem.headline: Standard & Poor's to take 9.6 pct stake in CRISIL.

text.p: Standard & Poor's, a leading global rating service, has signed a share purchase agreement to acquire a 9.6 percent stake in Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd, a company statement said on Friday.
"These shares are currently held by the Asian Development Bank, which invested in CRISIL in 1988 to play a catalytic role in its establishment," the statement said.
The share purchase agreement is awaiting approval by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
Standard & Poor's and CRISIL formed a strategic business alliance last year for analytical and business development cooperation.

"We are delighted to strengthen our ties with CRISIL, which continues to build its analytical capabilities and credibility in India and throughout the region," the statement quoted Leo C. O'Neill, president and chief rating officer for Standard & Poor's Ratings Services, as saying.
